sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi có thể nhận hành lý của mình ở đâu? is useful when the map, sign, or building layout is not giving you the final answer. It names pick up my luggage in a compact way, so a local can point, give a landmark, or send you to the right counter.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep it short: Tôi có thể nhận hành lý của mình ở đâu?. Show your booking screen, room key, address, room number, or photo of the issue, then listen for the first useful clue: a point, floor, street, counter, or landmark.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use this when you are already in the general area but need the final direction. It fits front desk, lobby, room, elevator, or booking conversation, especially when pick up my luggage can be pointed to on a map, sign, booking, or nearby landmark.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Directions in Vietnam are often answered with pointing plus a few words. That is useful: watch the gesture first, then ask a follow-up if you need the street, floor, or entrance repeated.
